rows.col_7: Appointment as Chief Executive Officer of SiCSem Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary of the Company.

Mr. Rajesh Nair has over 30 years of executive leadership experience across semiconductor business units, technology R&D and factory operations. Prior to joining SiCSem, he served as Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President for Process Integration and R&D at Tata Electronics, where he was one of the senior executives responsible for setting up India’s first 300mm wafer fab. Before Tata Electronics, he spent eleven years at GlobalFoundries, in Singapore and the US in Technology Development and Business Unit roles. Raj was Vice President and General Manager, Analog/Power and Embedded NVM, a USD 2 billion revenue business. Earlier in his career, he held senior fab operations, technology development and engineering leadership roles at Johnson Controls, ON Semiconductor and Motorola. Raj has previously served on the Advisory Board of the India Semiconductor Mission and holds seven US patents. Mr. Nair holds a B. Tech in Chemical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, an M.S. in Chemical Engineering from Syracuse University, and an M.S. in Electrical Engineering from National Technological University, USA.
